description: This file is a localization language resource for CKEditor 4, specifically for the Latvian ('lv') language. It defines Latvian translations for special characters used within the CKEditor plugin 'specialchar'. The file sets language-specific labels for special characters, such as currency symbols, punctuation marks, and accented Latin characters.

methods.name: setLang
methods.description: A method of the CKEDITOR.plugins namespace used to set language translations for plugins.
